name: Account Ownership Type 4 Code
definition: Specifies the type of account ownership.

UNCO.name: Unincorporated
UNCO.definition: Account owner is an unincorporated partnership or is of sole proprietorship.

LIPA.name: Limited Partnership
LIPA.definition: Account owner is a limited partnership or is of sole proprietorship.

CUST.name: Custodial Account
CUST.definition: Minor's account, registered in the minor's name. Since the minor cannot legally own property, the custodian of the account maintains control of the account.

EURE.name: EU Residual Entity
EURE.definition: Account owner is an entity located in the European Union which can be considered neither as a legal entity (for example, company, corporate), nor as an individual person, nor as a UCITS (Undertakings for Collective Investment of Transferable Securities) fund.

PART.name: Formal Partnership
PART.definition: Account owner is a contractual business organisation in which two or more individuals agree to pool their funds to manage and operate a business.

TRUS.name: Formal Trust
TRUS.definition: Account owner is an organisation which is engaged as a trustee for individuals or businesses in the administration of services such as stock transfer, registration, trust funds.

GOVO.name: Government Organisation
GOVO.definition: Account owner is a government organisation.

JOIT.name: Joint Account
JOIT.definition: Two or more individuals of legal age own shares of the same account.

COMO.name: Joint Account In Common
COMO.definition: Two or more individuals of legal age own shares of the same account. Upon the death of one of the account owners, the respective percentage of the ownership is transferred to the deceased's estate.

JOIN.name: Joint Account With Survivorship Rights
JOIN.definition: Two or more individuals own shares of the same account. Upon the death of one of the account owners, the entire account ownership is passed onto the surviving owners.

LLCO.name: Limited Liability Company
LLCO.definition: Account is for a limited liability company.

NOMI.name: Nominee
NOMI.definition: Account owner is a person or firm into whose name securities or other properties are transferred in order to facilitate transactions whilst leaving the customer as the actual owner.

NFPO.name: Non Profit Organisation
NFPO.definition: Account owner is an association that is given tax-free status due to the nature of their activities such as charity organisation.

ONIS.name: Other Non Individual
ONIS.definition: Account owner is another type of non individual organisation.

RGIC.name: Registered Investment Company
RGIC.definition: Account is for a registered investment company.

SIGL.name: Single Owner Account
SIGL.definition: Account has only one individual owner.
